info.title: Backlog API
info.description: Projects, members, backlog items and sources. Errors use RFC 9457 problem details (`application/problem+json`). Authenticate with a Keycloak access token (audience `backlog-api`).

patch.summary: Change title, document and/or status (requires If-Match)
patch.description: Send `If-Match: <version>`. A stale version returns 409 `version-conflict` with `currentVersion`, `changedSections` (sections changed since the version you based the edit on) and the current `item`. Status changes are validated against the allowed transitions (422 `invalid-status-transition`).

post.description: Rules: no self-links (422), both items in the project (404), no duplicates (409; `related-to` is symmetric), one parent per item (409), no parent cycles (409) and only capability → feature/enabler and feature → user-story/enabler as `parent-child` (422).
